entries: We are ready to travel to the deepest places.
我们已准备好前往最深处。
First you must pass the threshold to the Lacunaria.
首先，你们必须越过通往拉库纳里亚的门槛。
Use your Arcane Sight on the gateway in the center of this place; the archway surrounded by water.
对此地中央的传送门使用你的奥术视觉；就是那座被水环绕的拱门。
If you pass through with the material, the portal should stabilize and stay open.
若你带着那种材料穿过，传送门应当会稳定下来，并保持开启。
I am glad that our search was not in vain.
我很高兴，我们的寻找没有白费。
All this time I was searching for myself.
这么久以来，我一直在寻找的，是我自己。
However, in order to pass through the portal you will need one more thing... a piece of planar material.
不过，要穿过传送门，你们还需要一样东西……一块位面材料。
No like name Lacunaria, but no scared either. Sound like...  Scaphin word for dry puddle.
不喜欢拉库纳里亚这个名字，但也不怕。听起来像……斯卡芬语里的「干水洼」。
This will reveal the moon runes.
When all the moons are at their peak, the runes will glow and the portal will open.
当三轮月亮同至极处，符文便会发光，传送门也会开启。
This parallel world... it must be full of wonder, and danger.
这个平行世界……一定充满了奇观，也充满了危险。
The place you must seek is neither above or below us. It is parallel, in a place called the Lacunaria.
你们要寻找的地方，既不在我们上方，也不在我们下方。它是平行的，位于一个叫拉库纳里亚的地方。
You have been there before. Now, you must go willingly.
你们曾到过那里。如今，你们必须心甘情愿地前往。
We are ready to help. We have not come all this way to stop here.
我们随时可以帮忙。走了这么远，不会就此止步。
When you find the gem, return it to me, and I will regain the memories that I stored away.
等你们找到那颗宝石，把它带回给我，我就能重拾自己封存的记忆。
It is good to finally find you.
Parallel places help Fae cross great distances. Might find other Fae as well.
平行的所在能助妖精跨越遥远的距离。也许还能找到别的妖精。
Where are they? How can we return them to you?
他们在哪儿？我们怎样才能把他们还给你？
Nothing like a wild goose chase.
My notes tell of a mine to the west of Emerisk, in the Withering Hills, that emits planar energy.
我的笔记提到，埃梅里斯克以西的枯败丘陵有一处矿洞，会散发位面能量。
Search the mine, and hopefully you will find something of use. You will need the mine key.
搜索那座矿洞吧，但愿你们能有所收获。你们需要矿洞的钥匙。
This place connects all worlds and lands, filled with arcane objects.
这个地方连接着所有的世界与土地，遍布奥术器物。
This void pulls objects and entities into its emptiness through unknown means.
这片虚空以未知的方式，把器物与生灵拖入它的空无之中。
Its last known location was in the possession of a guardian of some kind, in the swamps below the mine.
它最后已知的下落，是在矿洞下方沼泽里某个守护者手中。
I hid my memories within this place to protect them.
为保护我的记忆，我把它们藏在了这里。
They lie bound in a unique gem called the Mynswar Opal.
它们被束缚在一颗独一无二的宝石里，称作明斯瓦蛋白石。
There is much I must tell you, but most of my memories are still hidden.
我有很多话必须告诉你，可我的大部分记忆仍被封存着。
I had to keep them safe, in case Kalindraur was not enough.
我必须保证它们的安全，以防卡林德劳尔还不够。
